about: The climb: Only Up!'s own level read from the player's install. Positions are in Only Up! cm and converted by games.onlyup.units_per_meter.

rows.asset: The .umap with the most StaticMeshComponents under /Game/Maps or /Game/*/Maps (listed in extract log)
rows.rule: Every StaticMeshComponent and InstancedStaticMeshComponent in its persistent level and streamed sublevels becomes a mesh + trimesh collider.
Bebop spawns here; fallback = lowest walkable mesh top near world origin.
v0.1 stretch: from spawn up to the first big landmark; a banner shows when Bebop passes 120 m above spawn (tune once the real map is read).
No checkpoints and no fall damage: a fall keeps you wherever you land, like Only Up!. Below the map's lowest mesh - 50 m respawns at spawn.
